question.prompt: \(AD\) is the median to side \(BC\) in \(\triangle ABC\). The area of \(\triangle ABC\) is \(30\text{ cm}^2\). Find the area of \(\triangle ABD\) (unit: cm²).

solutions.explanation: A median divides a triangle into two parts of equal area, so the area of \(\triangle ABD\) is \(30\div2=15\).
solutions.title: Halve the total area
